channel.title: Interval
channel.description: Interval is Sai Charan's film blog: sharp opinion, lists and breakdowns on Telugu, Tamil and Hindi cinema, from Pushpa and pan-Indian blockbusters to cult classics.

item.title: How Aditya Dhar Sells Stories: Dhurandhar and the Fiction Loophole
item.description: A critical reading of Aditya Dhar's Dhurandhar: how fiction becomes a shield for ideology, and how the film's method differs from URI and echoes Padmavat.

item.title: 10 Indian Filmmakers Who Redefined Cinema and Have Taken a Backseat
item.description: Mysskin, Bala, Thiagarajan Kumararaja, Chandrasekhar Yeleti, Farhan Akhtar and more: ten Indian directors who made exceptional cinema and have been quiet lately.

item.title: The Angry Man Formula: Misogyny and Toxic Masculinity in Pan-Indian Cinema
item.description: Why do pan-Indian blockbusters keep making the same angry, hyper-masculine hero? A look at misogyny, the male gaze and toxic masculinity as a box-office formula.

item.title: Box Office Failures That Became Cult Classics, Part 3
item.description: Part 3 of a list of Indian box office failures that became cult classics: Andaz Apna Apna, Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro, Bhavesh Joshi Superhero, Maqbool, Omkara, Hey Ram.

item.title: Pushpa Teaser Breakdown: Colour, Long Nails and Conviction
item.description: A design and cinematography breakdown of the Pushpa teaser: the teal-and-orange rule it breaks, the colour grade, the shot work, and why Pushpa's long nail matters.
